## arrowLeft

Go back to the previous page.

Field | Value             
----- | ------------------
Words | `back`, `previous`

An icon set registers the icon that draws this definition in its data file: `"map": {"arrowLeft": "<icon id>"}`. Find it in each installed set: `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon arrowLeft`.

Icon definitions are experimental: they may change or be removed in a patch release.
